messages:
maya_support: Customer upgraded @redwood/node-sdk to v0.24 and immediately hit 404s for chat endpoints. They report "endpoint not found" when calling /v1/chat/complete. Posting minimal repro and curl below.

josh_engineer: Can you paste package.json + lockfile lines and the exact request body/headers? Also need request-id if available.

maya_support: From customer: 
```json
// package.json snippet
"dependencies": {"@redwood/node-sdk": "^0.24.0"}
```
Node snippet (redacted):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] });
```
Error: 404 { error: 'route not found', path: '/v1/chat/complete' }
Headers they sent: 
- Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
- Content-Type: application/json

josh_engineer: Hmm. They used `chat.create` method which maps to server path `/v1/chat/complete` in current SDK. Can you get a sample request-id or a full curl so we can correlate logs?

maya_support: Customer sent this curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/complete" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
They pasted a 404 response with `x-rw-request-id: 01G7Z9KQ2A8`

rachel_sdk: I pulled the logs for request 01G7Z9KQ2A8. The server returned 404 because production routing expects the path `/v1/chat/completions` (plural) for the current API. SDK v0.24 shipped a rename that maps `chat.create` -> `/v1/chat/complete` (singular) — we introduced an incompatible client-side route mapping before the server rollout. Root cause: SDK and control plane are out of sync.

josh_engineer: Oof. Is this the same rename we discussed in the API versioning doc? I thought we kept backward-compatible aliases.

rachel_sdk: We intended to ship a compatibility shim on the API gateway, but that change failed validation in canary and wasn't promoted. SDK publish went ahead due to a release pipeline race.

tom_support: Customer is blocked in prod. What are mitigation options we can give them now?

rachel_sdk: Short term: downgrade to @redwood/node-sdk@0.23.x (pre-rename) or switch the request path to `/v1/chat/completions` and rename the param `model` -> `modelId` depending on what their error shows. Also, as a temporary server-side workaround we can enable the legacy routing flag `X-Use-Legacy-Routes: true` on the gateway for their account. Need infra approval.

liu_oncall: Scheduling a quick gateway shim rollout. I'll open a P0-ish incident to enable legacy aliasing for the affected tenant and then promote a global shim if canary looks good. ETA 30–90m.

infra_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-324 (legacy-route-shim). On-call: liu_oncall. Canary deploy queued.

maya_support: Told customer: options are downgrade (0.23), change path/param on their side, or we can apply temporary gateway flag. They want us to fix it.

rachel_sdk: I'll prepare a quick hotfix to map `chat.create` to the new server path and publish 0.24.1 with compatibility mapping so customers who upgrade don't break. Also adding a smoke test against staging API paths.

josh_engineer: Please include a changelog note and an explicit migration paragraph so customers don't accidentally jump. Also add a CI assert to block SDK publish if gateway shim isn't present.

liu_oncall: Canary looks good at +5m. Enabling legacy routing for tenant: redwood-cust-42.

infra_bot: Deployment success: gateway-shim v1.0.3 promoted to canary -> 200 reqs sampled, 0 errors.

maya_support: Customer confirmed they can call the endpoint now and returned 200s. They accepted the temporary workaround while SDK team ships patch. :thumbsup: 

rachel_sdk: Created GH issue RW-SDK-512: "restore backward-compatible chat route mapping, block future publish race". Assigned to @rachel_sdk, ETA 2h for 0.24.1, 24h for follow-up CI guard.

tom_support: I'll follow up with the customer with notes + ticket links and mark the support case resolved once release is out.

josh_engineer: Recommend adding an automated test that runs a small request against the prod gateway contract before any SDK publish.

rachel_sdk: Agreed. I'll add it to the release checklist. Closing thread after patch merge.

infra_bot: Patch merged and released: RW-SDK v0.24.1. Gateway shim removal scheduled after 24h.

maya_support: Closing—customer happy. Will reopen if we see regressions.
